notes_for_editor: The record point (45.88694, -77.88944) lies about 20 km west of the Barron Canyon Trail coordinates on the Algonquin Park site (45.889509, -77.635245). Barron Canyon is a viewpoint, not a fire tower. No source places the tower, so treat the point as unverified. Firelookout.ca detail pages fetch as empty index pages, so the only usable text is the ?slug= page. Wikipedia pages for Barron Canyon and Bangor, Ontario did not resolve. Two WebSearch calls used. Worth checking the 1963 and 1977 map sheets or Forest History Ontario and Algonquin Park archives for the build date and what stands today.
